mapper.select: select system_user_dept.id, system_user_dept.user_id, system_user_dept.dept_id, system_dept.name as deptName from system_user_dept left join system_dept on system_dept.id = system_user_dept.dept_id where system_user_dept.user_id = #{id} and system_dept.deleted = 0 and system_dept.status = 0 and system_user_dept.status = 0
